description: MySQL InnoDB Cluster - comprehensive metrics for CCX deployments. Requires prom/mysqld-exporter with performance_schema=ON and innodb_monitor_enable=all.
title: cmon-db-monitoring

panels.title: Buffer Pool Used %
panels.description: Uses mysql_global_status_buffer_pool_pages{state=...} (this exporter build has no separate "dirty" state, so this tracks used vs free, not dirty pages specifically).

panels.title: Buffer Pool Pages
panels.description: Uses mysql_global_status_buffer_pool_pages{state="data"|"free"|"misc"} (this exporter build has no separate "dirty" state).
Top 20 tables by total size (data + index). Requires mysqld-exporter flag --collect.info_schema.tables.
panels.title: Top Tables by Size

panels.description: Estimated row counts per schema. Requires --collect.info_schema.tables.
panels.title: Estimated Rows per Schema

panels.description: Top tables by I/O wait time. Requires --collect.perf_schema.tableiowaits and performance_schema=ON.
panels.title: Top Tables by I/O Waits

panels.description: Z-score of slow query rate vs 2h baseline. Z > 2 = unusual, Z > 3 = anomalous.
panels.title: Slow Queries Z-score

panels.description: Z-score of active connections. Spike may indicate connection leak or load surge.
panels.title: Connections Z-score

panels.description: Z-score of row lock wait rate. High Z = unusual lock contention.
panels.title: Lock Waits Z-score

panels.description: Z-score of query throughput. High or very low Z may indicate workload anomaly.
panels.title: QPS Z-score

panels.description: Z-score of InnoDB data write rate.
panels.title: I/O Writes Z-score

panels.description: Z-score of buffer pool hit rate. Negative Z (below -2) = hit rate is lower than usual = bad.
panels.title: Buffer Pool Hit Rate Z-score

panels.description: Z-score over time. Threshold lines at Z=2 (yellow) and Z=3 (red). Uses 2h rolling baseline.
panels.title: Slow Queries & Lock Waits - Z-score

panels.description: Z-score over time. Threshold lines at Z=2 (yellow) and Z=3 (red). Uses 2h rolling baseline.
panels.title: Connections & QPS - Z-score
